descriptions.organization-fields_create-field: Create a new custom field on a Zoho Desk module (tickets, contacts, accounts, tasks, calls, events, products, contracts, or activities). Required body: field type (Text, Number, Percent, Decimal, Currency, Date, DateTime, Email, Phone, Picklist, URL, Textarea, Boolean, Multiselect, or LargeText) selected via the discriminator, plus the per-type schema fields. Optional query: module (defaults to ticket scope). Returns the created field object with its generated id. Call this before referencing the new field in tickets or layout rules.
descriptions.organization-fields_get-field: Fetch a single custom field by id. Required path: fieldId. Returns the field object including its type, label, internal API name, and per-type validation rules (length, picklist values, etc.). Use this to discover the field's exact schema before composing requests against tickets or any module that includes that field.
descriptions.organization-modules_get-modules: List every Zoho Desk module accessible in the current org (tickets, contacts, accounts, tasks, calls, events, products, contracts, activities, plus any custom modules). No parameters. Returns each module's id, api_name, display_label, and whether it is custom. Use this to discover available custom modules before targeting them in field, layout, or search APIs.
descriptions.template-folders_delete: Permanently delete a template folder. Required path: folderId. Returns 204 No Content on success. Destructive and irreversible — templates inside the folder are NOT cascaded; reassign or delete them via templates_delete first. Confirm the folder is empty before calling.
descriptions.templates_delete: Permanently delete an email template. Required path: emailTemplateId. Returns 204 No Content on success. Destructive and irreversible — automations and macros that reference the template will fail at send time until updated. Audit dependent workflows before calling.
descriptions.uploads_file: Upload a file to Zoho Desk's attachment store and obtain a reusable upload reference. Required multipart body: file (the binary content). Returns an upload id and metadata (size, type, name) that can be attached to tickets, comments, threads, or replies via their respective attachment endpoints. Use this when an endpoint expects an upload-id rather than raw bytes.
